special:
Production modular asset sheet for the approved concept boards in the references. Match these exact warm Chinese village pixel-art designs closely. Six detachable parts ONLY, arranged in a strict TWO columns by THREE rows grid. Transparent alpha background, clean generous margins, no glows, ground shadows, text or labels. Crisp chunky brown outlines, subtle elevated three-quarter camera, warm rounded wood and pale irregular stone, rich readable pixel clusters. These are small composable pieces to reproduce the complete designs, NOT generic icons.
Row1 left: Wooden stone-thrower sling head exactly like the stone tower concept: two thick wooden posts forming a broad Y, rope stretched between the top two rounded caps and a large dark leather sling pocket hanging in the middle. No tower/platform/ground below. Sturdy short proportions. Row1 right: Circular pavilion straw canopy, wide round shallow conical golden straw roof viewed slightly from above, wood ring eave and empty small raised ROUND central mounting socket for a crystal; no crystal, posts or tower below.
Row2 left: Circular pavilion TEAL tiled canopy, same width/view/geometry as the straw canopy, golden wood round ridge collar with empty crystal mounting socket; simple warm gold eave edging, no crystal or structure below. Row2 right: Open-front log-workshop wall frame with cream upper half wall, timber vertical posts left and right, dark rear wall inside open work bay, right wall side visible, flat top edge. NO roof, logs, tools or floor.
Row3 left: Small warm wooden porch canopy with low wide terracotta slope and TWO short supporting timber posts, matching the cottage repair concept, completely open beneath, no wall. Row3 right: Wide wooden upper-floor balcony FRONT railing in the same three-quarter angle as cottage concept, thick rounded corner posts, short vertical pickets, a small side return visible, no floor or building behind.
Only these six components. Exact 2x3 arrangement, consistent art style. Preserve transparency between the arms of the sling, between posts and below canopy. No rectangular colored cells, no scene backgrounds.
